reason: Instagram already fills my room and it costs me nothing. I've paid for promo apps that brought nobody, so I'm not paying anyone until I see real people using it.
objection: A new app with no audience yet. Free listing is fine, but I've heard 'we'll bring you crowds' before and nobody showed up.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a published user count above 2,000 in my city and a few venues I know saying it actually sent people through the door.
